modules.name: Progressive Tax Brackets
modules.summary: Adds higher marginal rates on top earners. Funds the bill, raises opposition from wealth groups, lifts deficit relief.
modules.previewText: raises marginal income tax on filers earning over $400,000 by three percentage points

modules.name: Clean Energy Credit
modules.summary: Refundable tax credit for renewable installations. Pleases environmentalists, mild deficit cost.
modules.previewText: establishes a refundable tax credit covering thirty percent of qualifying solar, wind, and storage installations

modules.name: Collective Bargaining Protections
modules.summary: Strengthens union recognition and right-to-organize. Lifts working-class loyalty, raises business opposition.
modules.previewText: preempts state right-to-work statutes for workplaces engaged in interstate commerce

modules.name: Five-Year Sunset Clause
modules.summary: Bill expires unless reauthorized. Lowers opposition (the cost is bounded), no direct effects.
modules.previewText: expires five years after enactment unless reauthorized by joint resolution

modules.name: Rural Investment Set-Aside
modules.summary: Reserves 20% of program funding for counties under 50k population. Wins moderate rural support.
modules.previewText: reserves twenty percent of program disbursements for counties with populations under fifty thousand

modules.name: Strict Enforcement Penalties
modules.summary: Doubles civil penalties and adds an inspector general. Polarising — sharper effect, sharper opposition.
modules.previewText: doubles civil penalties and authorizes a dedicated inspector general with subpoena power

modules.name: Bipartisan Oversight Commission
modules.summary: Equal D/R commission supervises rollout. Reduces opposition; sometimes slows implementation.
modules.previewText: establishes a six-member oversight commission with equal partisan representation

modules.name: Emergency Appropriation Trigger
modules.summary: Activates supplemental funding when GDP growth falls below 1%. Counter-cyclical, raises long-term deficit.
modules.previewText: authorizes supplemental appropriations whenever annualized GDP growth falls below one percent

modules.name: School Modernization Grants
modules.summary: Targeted grants for district facilities and teacher retention in underfunded counties.
modules.previewText: directs federal grants to school districts with persistent infrastructure deficits and staffing shortages

modules.name: Permitting Reform Fast Track
modules.summary: Accelerates federal permit timelines with strict agency deadlines.
modules.previewText: imposes a one-year decision deadline for covered federal permitting actions

modules.name: Public Option Pilot
modules.summary: Creates a state opt-in public insurance pilot with federal backstop funding.
modules.previewText: creates a state opt-in public insurance pilot for counties with fewer than two private carriers

modules.name: Domestic Manufacturing Credit
modules.summary: Incentivizes domestic supply chain investment in strategic industries.
modules.previewText: offers a production tax credit for domestic manufacturing in strategic sectors

modules.name: Grid Reliability Standard
modules.summary: Sets minimum grid resilience standards and funds storage retrofits.
modules.previewText: requires utilities to meet federal reliability standards with phased storage benchmarks

modules.name: Labor Apprenticeship Fund
modules.summary: Scales union-employer apprenticeship pipelines for high-demand trades.
modules.previewText: appropriates matching funds for certified apprenticeship partnerships in high-demand trades

modules.name: Contract Transparency Disclosure
modules.summary: Requires public reporting for large contracts and major grant recipients.
modules.previewText: mandates quarterly public disclosure of federal contract performance and beneficiary ownership data

modules.name: Increased Services Funding
modules.summary: Provides additional funding for public services.
modules.previewText: allocates increased federal funding for essential public services

modules.name: Student Loan Forgiveness (Mild)
modules.summary: Forgives a portion of federal student loans for eligible borrowers.
modules.previewText: forgives up to $10,000 in federal student loans for eligible borrowers

modules.name: Student Loan Forgiveness (Aggressive)
modules.summary: Forgives a large portion of federal student loans for eligible borrowers.
modules.previewText: forgives up to $50,000 in federal student loans for eligible borrowers

modules.name: Student Loan Forgiveness (Complete)
modules.summary: Forgives all federal student loans for eligible borrowers.
modules.previewText: forgives all federal student loans for eligible borrowers

modules.name: Universal Basic Income
modules.summary: Provides a guaranteed monthly income to all citizens.
modules.previewText: establishes a universal basic income program providing a guaranteed monthly payment to all citizens

modules.name: Means-Tested Phase-In
modules.summary: Starts benefits with lower-income households first. Reduces fiscal shock, adds administrative complexity.
modules.previewText: phases eligibility by household income over three fiscal years

modules.name: State Waiver Lane
modules.summary: Lets states request tailored implementation plans. Wins federalist votes, risks uneven rollout.
modules.previewText: permits states to request implementation waivers that meet federal outcome benchmarks

modules.name: Small Business Exemption
modules.summary: Exempts firms under 50 employees from the most expensive compliance duties.
modules.previewText: exempts employers with fewer than fifty employees from covered compliance mandates

modules.name: Data Privacy Guardrails
modules.summary: Limits data collection and adds audit rights for programs handling personal records.
modules.previewText: requires data minimization, independent audits, and a private right to request record correction

modules.name: Carbon Border Adjustment
modules.summary: Adds fees on high-emission imports. Funds climate programs, provokes trade-sensitive opposition.
modules.previewText: levies a border adjustment fee on covered high-emission imports

modules.name: Public-Private Partnership Authority
modules.summary: Lets agencies partner with private firms for rollout. Speeds delivery but raises oversight concerns.
modules.previewText: authorizes competitive public-private partnerships for program delivery and infrastructure buildout

modules.name: Independent Appeals Board
modules.summary: Creates an appeals process for affected citizens, businesses, or states.
modules.previewText: creates an independent appeals board with published decisions and expedited review deadlines

modules.name: Rural Workforce Clinics
modules.summary: Funds mobile training and service clinics in medically or economically underserved counties.
modules.previewText: funds mobile workforce and service clinics in counties designated as economically underserved
